# nd_policy (Resource)

Resource to configure a switch policy or policy group on Nexus Dashboard

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nd_policy" "test_resource_policy_1" {
  is_policy_group       = false
  deploy                = true
  entity_name           = "SWITCH"
  entity_type           = "switch"
  description           = "Enable LACP"
  template_name         = "feature_enable"
  source                = "UNDERLAY"
  priority              = 500
  serial_numbers        = ["FDO245206N5", "FDO245206N6"]
  policy_parameters     = { "featureName" : "lacp" }
  secondary_entity_name = "MyNetwork_30000"
  secondary_entity_type = "configProfile"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entity_name` (String) Name of the entity. Use SWITCH when entity_type is switch
- `entity_type` (String) Type of the entity
- `serial_numbers` (Set of String) Switch serial numbers (or management IPs). Exactly one when is_policy_group is false. One or more when is_policy_group is true
- `template_name` (String) Name of the configuration template. Changing this value requires replacement

### Optional

- `deploy` (Boolean) When true, push the policy (pushConfig) or deploy member switches (policy group) after create/update
- `description` (String) Description of the policy
- `is_policy_group` (Boolean) When true, manage a policy group (multiple switches). When false, manage a single-switch policy
- `policy_parameters` (Map of String) Name/value pairs passed to the template as templateInputs
- `priority` (Number) Write priority of the policy (1–2000). Defaults to 500
- `secondary_entity_name` (String) Secondary entity name, for example an overlay name when entity_type is configProfile
- `secondary_entity_type` (String) Secondary entity type
- `source` (String) Source of the policy. Empty source means any source can update the policy

### Read-Only

- `fabric_name` (String) Name of the fabric resolved from serial_numbers in the switch inventory
- `generated_config` (String) CLI produced from the template and inputs
- `policy_id` (String) Controller-assigned policy ID (POLICY-<n> or POLICY-GROUP-<n>)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by policyId (POLICY-<n> or POLICY-GROUP-<n>)
terraform import nd_policy.test_resource_policy POLICY-26910
terraform import nd_policy.test_resource_policy POLICY-GROUP-143310
```
